name: the-human-c-suite
description: Agent skills for running a company without losing your humanity.

plugins.name: the-human-c-suite
plugins.description: The Human C-Suite: humane, technical CEO, CFO, CTO, CPTO and CHRO skills that ground advice in company data, treat layoffs as a last resort, show every saving net of its costs, measure AI before banking on it, plan to real capacity, judge people on their work instead of a curve, check pay equity, redeploy people when AI takes over work, borrow European and Nordic social practice and invite pushback.
